Initial release of greenhelix-bundle-ops-production.

- Launches a bundle for operating AI agent systems in production environments.
- Includes 5 guides covering fleet management, production hardening, observability, QA/chaos testing, and incident response.
- Bundle offers a combined $225 value at a $149 price point.
- Compatible with openclaw.
